#summary How types are translated between AS and Python

== Python -> AS3 ==

|| Python || AS3 ||
|| None || NULL ||
|| True || true ||
|| False || false ||
|| int || int ||
|| long, float || Number ||
|| str, unicode || String ||
|| dict || Object ||
|| list, tuple || Array ||
|| xml.dom.minidom.Document || XML, XMLDocument ||
|| datetime || Date ||

== AS3 -> Python ==

|| AS3 || Python ||
|| null || None ||
|| undefined || None ||
|| true || True ||
|| false || False ||
|| int || int ||
|| Number || float ||
|| String || unicode ||
|| Object, MixedArray || dict ||
|| Array || list ||
|| XML, XMLDocument || xml.dom.minidom.Document ||
|| Date || datetime ||
